player_prompt.intro:
Mukusambira Sokoban puzzle. Iwe ndi mcheza wakuwonetsa na inu mukufunika kubaditsa masanduku onse ku malango.
        Osati m'malo mwa masanduku, mungabadile kunoza m'malo woyamba.
        Inu sangabadile masanduku kupita kwa magalagala, komanso inu sangabadile masanduku.
        Pa bodi, zinthu zinali ndi zochitika:
        - Mcheza (iwe) ukhale 'P'
        - Magalagala ndiyo yanayowonetsedwa na '#' 
        - Masanduku yanapimwa ndi 'X'
        - Malango opanda masanduku yanayowonetsedwa na 'O'
        - Masanduku ku malango yanayowonetsedwa na '√'
        Inu ndi kugwiritsa [w] kuleka juu, [a] kuleka kushoto, [s] kuleka kumwera, na [d] kuleka kumpoto.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mvuto wakuwonetsa si wotere woyenera. Tumia [up], [down], [left], [right] kapena [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.not_valid_action: Kusuntha kumene kwaperekedwa sikunali kuchitapo kanthu koyenera.

outcome.win: Tikukuyamikirani chifukwa chothetsa vuto la Sokoban!
outcome.turn_limit: Mlingo wa kutembenuka kwafika. Simunathetse vutoli.
